lines.trans: Something happened in the studio.
What's wrong?
The brothers on site went to eat at noon, the result was food poisoning, all of them entered the hospital.
Originally the site was already short of people, the semi-finals are going to be recorded right away again,
Must hurriedly think of a way to dispatch people.
In the boss's name, sent an email to the whole department. You go dispatch people.
Okay.
I can go to the site team to help.
You cannot.
Let her go. The chief editor's office is not short of people, real production is also not what she can do.
The chief editor's office is not short of people? The chief editor's office is always short of people okay.
Do you know how much work we stack up every day to do?
Hasn't it always been just you two people? Look, because other people were all abused to death, abused to disability, abused to running away by you, big brother!
This one counts as running the slowest?

examples.trans: Great chatting today, see you next time!

meanings.note: Negator bù; rises to bú before a 4th-tone syllable.

examples.trans: This does not count as a big problem.
That is it not is good.

meanings.note: Adverb yě placed strictly before the verb.

examples.trans: This is also a good thing.

meanings.note: Particle le marking completion after a verb or a new situation at the end of a sentence.

examples.trans: We need to do the initial artist selection.
I am going to the office tomorrow.
Xin Huimei released a new song!

examples.text: 毕业以后可以留在星天。
examples.trans: You can stay at Xingtian after graduation.

meanings.note: Sentence-final particle ma turning a statement into a yes-no question.
Final particle ba softening suggestions ('let's') or seeking confirmation ('right?').
Colloquial sentence-final particle ya softening a question.

examples.trans: Why did you ask me out here?
What will she do in which department?

meanings.note: Third-person female pronoun tā, pronounced identically to 他.
Adverb jiù marking immediacy, 'just/merely', or a direct consequence.

examples.trans: If nobody wants her, she stays.

meanings.note: Used both as noun ('job / work') and verb ('to work'), canonical pos noun.

examples.trans: Do you want this job or not?
She works in the chief editor's office.

meanings.note: Particle de introducing a degree/manner complement (睡得不好), or verb děi ('must').
Question word zěnme asking 'how?' or 'what happened?'.
